title.value: Precision public health: Dream or reality?
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning and in the citation.
title.quote: Suggested citation: Dobbins M, Buckeridge D. Precision public health: Dream or reality? Can Commun Dis Rep 2020;46(6):160. https://doi.org/10.14745/ccdr.v46i06a01

analysis.description: The paper discusses the potential and current state of precision public health, examining whether its anticipated benefits are realistic or overly ambitious.

type.justification: The paper discusses a pilot project and surveys, indicating practical investigation and analysis.
type.quote: A pilot project to code the research evidence of interventions related to influenza control illustrated that it is possible to create a coded knowledge base of influenza control interventions...

name.justification: The paper focuses on public health, specifically precision public health, as evident from its discussion and title.
name.quote: Precision public health (PPH) is defined as an 'emerging practice to more granularly predict and understand public health risks...'

name.justification: The paper mentions recent investments in informatics related to public health.
name.quote: Recent investments in public health and informatics, however, place Canada at the forefront of this emerging field.
